exact_statement: Let p,q be complete finite probability laws with CE(p,q)<infinity, pi a partition, and prescribed child profiles r+,r- with mean pi(q). Among complete references R+,R- with pi(Rtau)=rtau and (R++R-)/2=q, the mean CE increase is minimized by minimizing -(1/2) sum_{p(s)>0} p(s) log2(1-t(s)^2), subject to Rtau(s)=q(s)(1+tau*t(s)) and sum_{pi(s)=z}q(s)t(s)=Delta(z)=(r+(z)-r-(z))/2. Its minimum is zero iff |Delta(z)|<=g(z)=sum_{pi(s)=z,p(s)=0}q(s) for every block. Beyond that capacity, ghost tilts saturate at sign Delta and the unique occupied minimizer satisfies p(s)t(s)/(1-t(s)^2)=lambda(z)q(s), with lambda fixed by the block constraint; fully one-sided occupied boundaries have infinite cost. If p,q have matching conditionals in each occupied block, the minimum equals -(1/2)sum_z pi(p)(z) log2(1-((r+(z)-r-(z))/(2*pi(q)(z)))^2). For every coherent Boolean controller G=a+sigma*(1-a^2)*parity4 on disjoint variables, the explicit complete references of DERIVATION section4a achieve a prescribed nonempty profile change, proper only if E(1-a^2)>0, at zero CE increment after querying the fourth seed bit, with zero erasure, JS, occupancy refund and phase products.
